inspection.title: Spire of Dublin primary and fabrication references
inspection.notes: Inspected architect/fabricator photographs, including the base pattern, concentric grating and bollards. The science publication was read as text, not inspected as PDF pixels.

sourceAndRuntimeKhronos.notes: Validator reports informational UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION for EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing; assembly tests and the shared viewer independently exercise instance transforms and full draw count.

limitations: Maximum fidelity remains pending: the unique base stencil and its azimuth, eight fabrication frusta and joints, exact hole layout, maintenance fittings, current bollards and night illumination. The core-strata pattern and perforation row layout are original approximations with published dimensions/counts; they are not fabrication drawings. Exact-QID OSM way 96578181 supports the center. Its 2.2 m footprint and 121.2 m height differ from the published 3 m base and 120 m height; the original published dimensions are retained. Ground datum, precise pedestal bounds, stencil azimuth, bollard arrangement and current site fit remain pending. No placement activated.
